Apartment overview

- WE ALLOW 10% DISCOUNT, UPON REQUEST FOR 7 DAYS OR LONGER excluding July, August, Easter and Christmas periods.

THIS IS 5\* CLUB PLAYAS DEL DUQUE - BEACHFRONT iN PUERTO BANUS

We are in the most prestigious and central location on the Costa del Sol. A car is not needed although free indoor parking is available on site.

5\* Club Playas del Duque in Puerto Banus with 30,000 sq, meters of tropical gardens, 3 large pools with lifeguard, 2 restaurants, 24/7 concierge service and a securely fenced development. The world famous The Ocean Club is on our beach with free entry - fees payable for loungers.

- Direct access from our garden gates directly onto the beach and into Marina Puerto Banus
- TWO bedrooms and TWO bathrooms
- The apartment is fully air-conditioned for heating and cooling. Very large and bright property of

160 sq. meters in size
- High speed WiFi - Free, limitless downloads and unlimited devices
- 55-inch TV with internet streaming package offering thousands of international channels including

most of the UK channels, in many languages with films, sports and children’s

programmes
- One bathroom has a walk-in shower, the second bathroom is with a bathtub and shower
- The apartment and development are family friendly, wheelchair accessible and sleeps up to 5

people
- Key collection is 24/7
- Safety deposit box
- Baby Cots, cot linens and high chairs are available on request
- Marina Puerto Banus adorned with shops, restaurants, bars, nightlife and also the casino is just few

minutes walk from our apartment. Shopping is available 24/7
- This is Costa del Golf with more than 50 international courses of different characteristics, all within

half an hour drive from the apartment
- Old Marbella town is a few minutes drive away or can be reached by the frequent public bus

service, stopping in front of our development
- Here we have the best climate in Europe during Summer and Winter
- Over 50% of our reservations are repeat visitors. Multiple 5\* reviews can be seen on our own

website

WHAT'S INCLUDED IN THE COST:.... No extra or hidden charges.

- All taxes and utilities
- Arrival and departure cleaning
- Parking in secure garage inside the building
- IPTV - Internet streaming package for all types of tv channels
- Bed linens, towels and pool towels
- Air conditioning (cooling/heating)
- Two hair dryers
- Liquid soap in bathrooms
- Dishwasher tablets & some cleaning products
- Use of the safety deposit box

The waterfront boardwalk from our garden gate, offers convenient access for wheelchair and pushchair accessibility taking only a few minutes walk to the beach and Marina Puerto Banus.

Marbella and San Pedro can be reached by walking the length of the boardwalk

Health & beauty services are located in various retail units within Club Playas del Duque, with a Gymnasium provided by Moma Fitness Club along with

Spinning, Yoga, Pilates, and many other classes. An entry fee is payable. Please see Moma's Facebook page.
